article_title: Russia-Ukraine war: Zelensky expects war to continue after US envoy talks

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: US envoys holding talks in Moscow and Kyiv without announcing a breakthrough, while Zelensky prepares for the war to continue into winter
Ukraine and Russia signing a final peace treaty in Kyiv
The US ending all discussions with both sides
Russia withdrawing from all occupied Ukrainian territory
tasks.correct_answer: US envoys holding talks in Moscow and Kyiv without announcing a breakthrough, while Zelensky prepares for the war to continue into winter
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת שיחות אמריקאיות במוסקבה ובקייב שלא הניבו פריצת דרך פומבית, בעוד זלנסקי נערך להמשך המלחמה בחורף.

tasks.prompt: Who were the two US envoys involved in the talks?
options: Yuri Ushakov and Volodymyr Zelensky
Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner
Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin
Two Ukrainian air-force commanders
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השליחים האמריקאים היו סטיב ויטקוף וג׳ארד קושנר, שביקרו במוסקבה ולאחר מכן בקייב.

tasks.prompt: What support did Zelensky say Ukraine would need if the war continued into winter?
options: New agricultural exports and tourist visas
Air defence and energy support
Only additional railway carriages
A ban on all international meetings
tasks.explanation_hebrew: זלנסקי הדגיש שבחורף אוקראינה תזדקק להגנה אווירית ולסיוע בתחום האנרגיה.

tasks.prompt: Why is winter energy support especially important for Ukraine?
options: Ukraine produces no electricity in summer
Russia has targeted Ukrainian energy infrastructure during previous winters
The envoys plan to close every power station
Patriot interceptors are used to heat homes
tasks.correct_answer: Russia has targeted Ukrainian energy infrastructure during previous winters
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בשנים קודמות רוסיה מיקדה תקיפות בתשתיות האנרגיה בחורף, ולכן המשך הלחימה יוצר צורך מיוחד בהגנה ובסיוע.

tasks.prompt: What does “substantive” mean when Witkoff describes the Kyiv talks?
options: Secret and impossible to understand
Serious and focused on important issues
Brief and purely ceremonial
Conducted only through written notes
tasks.correct_answer: Serious and focused on important issues
tasks.explanation_hebrew: substantive פירושו מהותי ורציני — שיחה העוסקת בנושאים חשובים ולא רק במחוות סמליות.

tasks.prompt: What does “durable peace” mean in Kushner's comments?
options: A settlement designed to last and prevent renewed conflict
A three-day pause in strikes only
A military victory announced immediately
An agreement limited to economic projects
tasks.correct_answer: A settlement designed to last and prevent renewed conflict
tasks.explanation_hebrew: durable peace הוא שלום יציב ומתמשך, שאינו מאפשר חזרה מהירה לעימות או לתוקפנות.
